volunteerExperiences.companyName: Educational Tourism – Space and Life Program | Escola Parque
volunteerExperiences.description:
Collected donations of school supplies for children from Indigenous Communities in the Amazon region.
Had the rewarding opportunity to personally deliver the supplies to children from the Ribeirinha Tribe and the Kambeba Community living in the Amazon.
This experience allowed me to deeply engage with the children, learn about Indigenous culture, and gain valuable insight into ecology and environmental awareness.

projects.title: OC Performance Scheduling
projects.description:
- Developed and deployed a comprehensive web-based performance scheduling system for Oklahoma Christian University's Music Department that remains live and actively used by all music students, faculty, and accompanists to coordinate recital hearings, juries, and other musical performances.
- Architected a multi-role system supporting students, instructors, accompanists, and administrators with role-specific functionalities including event creation, availability management, time slot scheduling, performance critiques, grade tracking, and automated email notifications.
